Rashi on Nedarim 41b:1:1.hebrew: כי חיזרא לדיקלא - כמו האטד שמקיף הדקל ומגין לפירות שאין יכולים למשמש בו, כך מגינה על גופו של אדם:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:1:1.english: Like thorns for a palm tree - Like the thornbush that surrounds the palm tree and protects the fruit so that [one] cannot touch it, so [too, the fever] protects a person's body.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:1:2.english: Toreiki - Tiriaca [theriac, an antidote] in Old French.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:2:1.english: Chushla of barley - Old, hulled barley.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:2:2.english: Of the top of the sieve - [Those] that cling to the sieve and to the sifter when sifting with them.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:3:1.hebrew: בורדס - בסמ"ך, שילשול גדול שיוצא כל שעה כמעיין הנובע שאין לו שוליים, ויצאו ממנו כל המים. ואית דאמרי בורדם במ"ם, כמו בור שנובע דם. ואית דאמרי מכה שקורין בו"ן מלנ"ט, שיוצא נמי הימנו דם:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:3:1.english: Buredas - With a samekh: [It is] a severe diarrhea that comes out continually like a flowing spring that has no bottom, and all the water comes out from him. And there are those who say [that the reading is] buredam, with a mem, like a pit [bor] that flows with blood [dam]. And there are those who say [it is] a sore that is called bon malant [in Old French], from which blood also comes out.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:3:2.hebrew: מפני שהוא כמעיין הנובע - שקופץ מזה לזה, ויש בו סכנה להזכירו:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:3:2.english: Because it is like a flowing spring - For it leaps from one [person] to another, and there is danger in mentioning it.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:1.hebrew: [היכי קתני] - מתני', ומרפאו רפואת נפש:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:1.english: [How is it taught] - [Referring to] the Mishnah, "and he heals him [with] a cure of the soul."

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:2.english: For free - That is to say, he has no benefit, only that [the patient] is grateful to him in his soul.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:3.hebrew: רפואת נפש [גופו] - שאם חלה המדיר, מותר למודר לרפאותו, כדאמרינן לעיל דלא אדריה מן חיותיה:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:3.english: Cure of the nefesh [his body] - That if the one who imposed the vow fell ill, it is permitted for the one prohibited by the vow to heal him, as we said earlier, that he did not prohibit him [by vow] from his life.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:4.hebrew: רפואת ממון בהמתו - שאם חלתה בהמתו, אסור לרפאותה משום דקמהני ליה:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:4.english: A cure of property [means] his animal - That if his animal fell ill, it is forbidden to heal it, because he is benefiting him.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:4:5.english: However, he says to him, etc. - For speech is nothing.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:5:1.english: And he may bathe with him - [Meaning,] the one prohibited by the vow [may bathe] with the one who imposed the vow.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:5:2.english: However, not in a small [bath] - Because the water increases from him, and the heat also increases.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:6:1.hebrew: אבל לא מן התמחוי - ביחד, מפני שמרבה בעל הבית בשבילו:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:6:1.english: But not from the platter - [Eating] together, because the host increases [the portion] for him.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:7:1.hebrew: אבל אוכל הוא מן התמחוי החוזר - לבעל הבית, כדמפרש בגמרא, שדרכן לאכול מעט ומחזירו לבעל הבית, שיש להן מאכילין הרבה. וכיון דאין אוכל אלא מעט ומחזיר המותר, לא מיתהני מיניה כלום; אפי' אם אוכל חבירו פחות הימנו, לא מיתהני, דהא אינו אוכל אלא מעט והמותר מחזיר. ע"א: לא יאכל עמו מן התמחוי, דדרך בני הסעודה לאחר שאכלו כפי שובען מצניעין המותר ונושאים עמם לבתיהן — דהתם לא יאכל עמו, דשמא אחד מהן אוכל פחות מחבירו, ולכשיביאו מותרן לבתיהן חולקין בשוה, ונמצא זה משתכר במה שאכל חבירו פחות ממנו. אבל אם דרך בני הסעודה לאחר שאכלו מחזירין מותרן לבעל הבית, ושוב אין מוסיפין בקערות, מותר לאכול עמו:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:7:1.english: However, he may eat from a platter that returns - [that returns] to the host, as the Gemara explains, for it is their custom to eat a little and return it to the host, since they have many foods. And since he eats only a little and returns the remainder, he derives no benefit from him at all; even if his fellow eats less than him, he does not derive benefit, since he eats only a little and returns the remainder. Another explanation: he may not eat with him from the [common] platter, because it is the custom of the guests at the meal, after they have eaten to their fill, to put aside the remainder and carry [it] with them to their homes — in that case he may not eat with him, lest one of them eat less than his fellow, and when they bring their remainder to their homes they divide [it] equally, and thus this one profits from what his fellow ate less than him. However, if it is the custom of the guests at the meal that after they have eaten they return their remainder to the host, and no more is added to the bowls, it is permitted to eat with him.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:8:1.hebrew: לא יאכל עמו מן האבוס שלפני הפועלים - כלי גדול שנותן בו בעל הבית ירקות שאוכלין בו הפועלים יחד, ומשום טעם דתמחוי:
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:8:1.english: He may not eat with him from the trough that is before the laborers - [This is] a large vessel into which the homeowner puts vegetables that the laborers eat from together, and [this is] because of the reason of a serving bowl [tamchui].

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:8:2.hebrew: ולא יעשה עמו באומן - שלא יעמוד עמו במענה אחת, מפרש בגמ':
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:8:2.english: Nor may he work with him in [the same] row - That he should not stand with him in one furrow; [this] is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:9:1.hebrew: בקרוב כ"ע לא פליגי דאסור - לעדור, דקא מרפיא כו':
Rashi on Nedarim 41b:9:1.english: When [one is] proximate, everyone agrees that it is prohibited - to hoe [together], as he loosens [the earth], etc.

Rashi on Nedarim 41b:9:2.english: As he loosens the earth before him - And it is easy for him to plow after him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:1:1.hebrew: כי חיזרא לדקלא - שחריות שסביב לדקל מגין עליו כדקל, בלע"ז טורק"א:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:1:1.english: Like a thornbush for a palm tree - [This means] that the palm branches around the palm tree protect it like a palm tree [is protected], in Old French: torke [a twisted band].

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:2:1.english: From the beginning of the sifting - Fine flour of barley.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:3:1.english: Nor is its name mentioned - Because the sick person is embarrassed when [someone] mentions [it].

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:3:2.english: Bor dam [a pit of blood] - A pit flowing with blood from the lower parts [of the body].

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:1.hebrew: אילימא רפואת נפש בחנם - מיירי בנכסי חולה אסורין על הרופא, לכך שכר אסור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:1.english: If we say [that] "cure of the nefesh" [means] for free - [This] is dealing with [a case where] the sick person's property is forbidden to the doctor; therefore, [taking] a fee is forbidden.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:2.hebrew: אלא רפואת נפש גופו - ומיירי בשנכסי רופא אסורים על החולה, ורפואת גופו מותרת בנוטלין עליו שכר, ומצוה קעביד:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:2.english: Rather, a cure of the nefesh [means] his body - And [this] is speaking of [a case] where the doctor's property is forbidden to the patient, and curing his body is permitted [even] where people take a fee for it, as he is performing a mitzvah.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:3.hebrew: רפואת ממון בהמתו - דלא מצוה קעביד, הא קמהני ליה אף כי אין נוטלין עליהן שכר; ולא הוה כמו מחזיר אבידתו, דמצוה להשיב לו אבידתו, אבל אינו מצוה לרפא לו בהמתו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:3.english: Cure of property [means] his animal - For he is not performing a mitzvah; he is benefiting him even though they do not take payment for them. And it is not like one who returns his lost property, for it is a mitzvah to return his lost property to him, whereas he is not commanded to heal his animal.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:4.hebrew: אבל אומר לו סם פלוני יפה לה - דדיבור שרי לאחווי ולהנאותו מדיבורו. וי"א: "רפואת נפש — גופו", דמיירי שנכסי חולה אסורין על הרופא, ושרי לכנוס בביתו, דמן חיותו לא אדריה; אבל לא רפואת בהמתו, דמתהני מדריסת הרגל, ואפי' גבי צורך בהמתו אדריה כדאמרי' לעיל. "אבל אומר לו" — לא בבית, אלא בשוק. ולפי' ראשון ניחא טפי, דלפי' זה אמאי נקט "אומר"? אפי' לרפואת בהמתו, בידוע שלא בביתו, שרי! ותו, דמצי לפלוגי בין גופו לרפואת בנו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:4:4.english: "However, he says to him: Such and such medicine is beneficial for it" - For speech is permitted, to indicate [to him] and to benefit him through his speech. And some say [that] "a cure of the nefesh [means] his body" [means] that [the Mishnah] is speaking of a case where the sick person's property is forbidden [by a vow] to the doctor, and it is permitted [for the doctor] to enter his house, because regarding [what is needed for] his life he did not vow against him; but not the cure of his animal, because he benefits from treading [on the sick person's property], and even regarding the needs of his animal he vowed against him, as we said above. "However, he says to him" — not in the house, rather in the marketplace. And according to the first explanation it fits better, for according to this [second] explanation, why does [the Gemara] state "he says"? Even [to treat] for the cure of his animal, when it is known [that he is] not in his house, it is permitted! And furthermore, [the Gemara] could have distinguished between his own body and the cure of his son.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:1.english: "It is taught [in a baraita]: One may not bathe... whether in a large [one] or whether in a small [one]" - [This] refers to the bath.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:2.hebrew: גדולה - אם בימות הגשמים, וכ"ש בימות החמה; וקטנה בימות החמה, אבל לא בימות הגשמים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:2.english: A large [bed] - [is permitted] if [it is] during the rainy season, and all the more so during the summer; and a small [bed is permitted] during the summer, but not during the rainy season.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:3.hebrew: מזיע בקטנה - שמאחר שאינו אלא מזיע, לא מיתהני מיניה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:3.english: Sweating in a small [bath] - For since he is only sweating, he does not derive benefit from him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:4.hebrew: מן התמחוי החוזר לבעל הבית - פי': במתנה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:7:4.english: From the platter that returns to the host - Explanation: [It is] as a gift.

Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:9:1.hebrew: בקרוב כ"ע לא פליגי דאסור - דמרפה ליה ארעא קמיה, וניחא לחפור בה יותר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 41b:9:1.english: When [they are] proximate, no one disagrees that it is prohibited - For he loosens the earth before him, and it is easier to dig in it further.
